name: PINBOARD
author: hundekraft
description: PINBOARD is a synth built around a pin board, inspired by the EMS VCS3: its pin matrix, its diode-ladder filter, its ring modulator and its trapezoid envelope. It has two oscillators, a noise source, a ring modulator and a filter that squeals when you push it. A third oscillator runs slow or fast and is there to modulate the others. The board is a grid of eight sources and eight destinations.
